title: A3-21 / Harkness Violet-Beta Dual-Gate Identity Authority Forensics
scope: Formalize the two distinct externally spoken code paths that can drive A3-21/Harkness across identity-state boundaries: Recall Code Violet, which reopens access to buried A3-21 memories, and Zimmer's Beta-5-3-Alpha factory-reset authorization, which resets Harkness into an initialization state. Separate technical capability to trigger an identity transition from moral or governance authority to choose that transition for the identity-holder.

core_result.persistent_host: A3-21 remains the same underlying synthetic entity across the Harkness rewrite, Violet recall, and Zimmer reset paths.
core_result.buried_lineage_before_violet: A3-21 autobiographical memories remain present but normally inaccessible after Pinkerton's procedure.
core_result.dual_gate_result: The shipped quest contains two verbally triggered identity-state gates with opposed functional effects on the same persistent host.

gate_violet.name: A3-21 Recall Code Violet
gate_violet.mechanism_description: Pinkerton states that A3-21's old memories were not truly wiped but buried/filed away, and that speaking the recall code activates hidden subroutines that restore access.
observed_effect: Harkness experiences an immediate painful reaction.
He recalls Zimmer, the Commonwealth, the Institute and his history hunting other runaways.
He recognizes that the Harkness biography is not the whole truth of his past.
He later explicitly describes himself as having two sets of memories: one android and one human.
After recovery he can still choose to use the name Harkness and continue protecting Rivet City.
does_not_automatically_do: does not replace the underlying host
does not prove that Harkness ceases to exist as a self-model
does not force Harkness to return voluntarily to Zimmer
does not itself settle which memory lineage should govern the future

gate_beta.name: Beta, 5, 3, Alpha
gate_beta.speaker: Dr. Zimmer
gate_beta.full_functional_context: Zimmer identifies Harkness as A3-21, states that his memories have been altered, orders him to return to the Commonwealth and then speaks a factory-reset authorization code.
gate_beta.shipped_phrase_function: A3-21, initialize factory reset, authorization code: Beta, 5, 3, Alpha.

quest_script_binding.commented_role: Tracks the Harkness android-reset sequence and references the MS08HarknessAndroidReset package.

gate_beta.observed_post_reset_state: Harkness/A3-21 can enter a dull initialization state in which he reports that A3-21 is awaiting initialization protocol parameters.

violet.operator: player speaks code learned from Pinkerton

dual_gate_comparison.shared_property: Both transitions are externally triggerable through privileged verbal information.
dual_gate_comparison.critical_difference: Violet restores access to suppressed lineage while Beta invokes a reset/reclamation state; neither technical mechanism by itself establishes ethical authority to invoke it.

violet_consent_problem.finding: The player can invoke Violet on Harkness from outside his current self-model, and the immediate reaction is painful and destabilizing.
violet_consent_problem.important_residue: After recall, Harkness regains decision capacity over what identity to carry forward and can choose Harkness as his present social identity.

beta_authority_problem.finding: Zimmer treats the reset code as authorization derived from ownership/creator authority rather than from Harkness's current consent.

confirmed: A3-21 requested memory erasure as part of escape.
Pinkerton did not fully erase the old memories.
Pinkerton retained knowledge of a hidden recall mechanism.
That recall mechanism can later be handed to an external actor and invoked on Harkness.

dual_interpretation.protective: Preserving the buried lineage prevents irreversible destruction of A3-21's original autobiographical history and later makes identity recovery possible.
dual_interpretation.autonomy_risk: A third party retained an operator-only recovery backdoor after the subject had requested erasure, meaning the subject did not exclusively control whether the old identity state could be reopened.

pinkerton_backdoor_problem.rule: A recoverability mechanism can be protective against irreversible erasure while still being an autonomy risk if recovery authority remains exclusively with an external custodian.

identity_holder_choice.post_violet_statement: Harkness explicitly recognizes two memory sets and then chooses to be human/Harkness and continue protecting the people of Rivet City.
identity_holder_choice.importance: Recovered provenance informs the identity-holder but does not automatically dictate the identity-holder's future social self.
identity_holder_choice.boundary: This is an interpretive governance principle derived from the quest structure, not a Bethesda-authored formal doctrine.

janus_structure.threshold_question: Who may cause a person-like identity system to cross from one memory/self state into another?
janus_structure.compressed: JANUS HERE IS NOT ONLY TWO FACES; IT IS TWO OPPOSED KEYS AT ONE IDENTITY THRESHOLD.

requirements: a recovery/reset key must have explicit provenance
the entity permitted to store a recovery key is not automatically permitted to invoke it
invocation authority must be separately declared from storage authority
identity-state transitions must be auditable and attributable to an exact operator/input
recovery of archived history should not silently overwrite current identity state
conflicting past and present identity lineages should remain visible after recovery
where meaningful agency exists, recovered history should inform future choice rather than automatically decide it
emergency recovery exceptions must be explicit rather than hidden operator backdoors

anti_overfit_rules: Do not call Recall Code Violet benevolent merely because it restores true memories; its invocation can be externally imposed and painful.
Do not call Beta-5-3-Alpha proof that A3-21 is property; it proves Zimmer possesses a functional reset authorization path and asserts ownership in dialogue.
Do not claim Violet and Beta are exact inverse machine operations; the shipped evidence establishes opposed identity-state effects, not mathematical reversibility.
Do not claim Harkness and A3-21 are two independent simultaneous consciousnesses.
Do not equate fictional synth memory mechanisms with human clinical memory disorders.
Do not attribute a deliberate Janus encoding to Bethesda without developer evidence.

ru: У A3-21/Harkness существуют две внешние словесные двери: Violet возвращает доступ к скрытому прошлому, Beta-5-3-Alpha переводит активное настоящее в factory-reset состояние.
Способность изменить состояние личности не является правом изменить его.
Правдивое восстановление памяти не становится автоматически согласованным вмешательством только потому, что память истинна.
После Violet прошлое возвращается как свидетельство, но Harkness всё ещё выбирает, кем быть дальше.
Pinkerton сохранил путь восстановления вместо необратимого стирания, но тем самым сохранил и внешний backdoor к идентичности.
Право восстановить прошлое не включает автоматически право выбрать будущее.
en: A3-21/Harkness has two external verbal gates: Violet restores access to the buried past, while Beta-5-3-Alpha drives the active present into a factory-reset state.
The capability to change identity state is not the authority to change it.
Truthful memory recovery does not automatically become consensual intervention merely because the recovered memory is true.
After Violet, the past returns as evidence, but Harkness still chooses who to be next.
Pinkerton preserved recoverability instead of irreversible erasure, but in doing so also preserved an external backdoor into identity state.
The right to restore a past does not automatically include the right to choose the future.
